usedFor: WordPress is where posts get published, and Slack is where the team hears about it. “New Post Created” in WordPress can announce itself through “Send Message” in Slack.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post Created” in Wordpress, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: It tells the team the moment a post exists, and “Send Message” can target a channel by name or ID. “Send Interactive Message” suits a post that needs sign-off.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today. Going the other way, “New Message in Channels” is polling, so “Create Post” runs after the next check.
